'''''Thaere Runner''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that served in the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The ''Runner'' was used as a customs ship in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and when the [[Heroes of Cularin]] left [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to travel to [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], they were forced to dock their ship with it. The Thaereian officer [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Toric Bisilt]] asked the heroes questions about their intentions, while [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Desic Malboan]] of [[Thaereian Intelligence]] attached a tracking device to their ship. The Thaereians then released the heroes and they flew away from the ''Runner''.
